title: 课程资料中心与跨课程检索
outputs: 加密、按账号与学期隔离的课程资料索引
跨课程元数据与已读取公告正文检索
稳定资源清单与同内容/同名/多版本分组
批量下载预览、确认执行与逐项结果
安全归档路径与不覆盖写入
资料摘要导出与下载记录查询

security_summary.identity: source record id, never title; learn:FILE / learn:NOTICE_ATTACHMENT / learn:ASSIGNMENT_ATTACHMENT
security_summary.index_storage: 2.2 SecureStore, purpose INDEX, account_domain CAMPUS, service_domain LEARN; account and semester scoped; decrypted in memory only
security_summary.no_implicit_download: indexing and preview never call download_file; execution requires confirm=True for one process-local plan
archive: sanitised course component and title plus (uid, version) token
parent traversal, absolute paths, reserved Windows device names and overlong names refused
temp file plus hash re-check plus atomic replace
existing file never overwritten; identical content reused; different content reported as conflict
disk-full and locked-file failures keep the original file and leave no .part file
privacy: no absolute download directory in index, download records, export or errors
download records store destination_id hash and archive-relative path only
free-text source errors and warnings are reduced to stable code tokens
no socket/urllib/requests/http import; no print; socket guard test
export inside a Git work tree refused
security_summary.encryption_evidence: real AES-GCM SecureStore (file-key on Linux, DPAPI on Windows); no test encoder or disabled-encryption mode

validators.contracts: ok, 8 contracts / 9 schema samples / 35 rejection samples / 8 extra samples / 29 legacy tools

windows.note: no platform skip is declared; batch integration must run tests/test_resources.py on windows-2025

checks.setup_note: python scripts/dev.py setup-node installed 3 npm packages in this worktree; no package.json or lockfile change was committed

acceptance.case: same-title attachments from different courses keep identity and archive directory
index construction performs no download or upload
partial notice reading reports incomplete body coverage
one batch failure keeps successful items and continues
parent paths and reserved device names cannot escape the archive boundary
changed content after refresh becomes a new version instead of overwriting
another account cannot read index, references or download records
export and errors carry no unselected content or private path

limits: No PDF, image, Office or audio content parsing; full-text search covers only already-read notice body and assignment instructions, and body_coverage states the gap.
A notice without an attachment does not become a resource entry, so its body is not separately searchable.
Default reuse trusts a saved file with matching hash; same-version content change requires verify_known=True or a new source version.
The index is a bounded, in-memory-decrypted document (4 MiB, 2000 entries per semester), not an incremental full-text engine.
One writer per account and semester is assumed; the 2.2 store lock protects writes but the last write wins on concurrent read-modify-write.
Plans are process-local, expire after 10 minutes and are single-use; a restart requires a new preview.
STALE entries require allow_historical=True; MISSING entries require include_superseded=True.
Archive writes assume a single writer per destination; a concurrent writer gets a conflict, never an overwrite.
The module is not registered in queries.py, MCP or CLI; 6.1 owns the public facade and error-code registration.
This result is synthetic engineering evidence only; it does not prove a real campus read or download.

cross_module_requests.request: Register RESOURCE_* codes in contracts/v0.2/error-classification.json; expose ResourceCenter only, not Archive/Index; derive account scope with SecureStore.account_scope(purpose=INDEX, service_domain=LEARN).
Use stable_resource_uid and public fields only; do not read archive-relative paths or download directories. A resource reference is not local file read permission.
If the installed layout ships module docs, add resources/README.md to package-data; no new runtime dependency is required.
Include tests/test_resources.py in cross-platform regression; the file declares no platform skip, but Windows execution of os.open/os.replace and reserved device-name cases is still required.

Reconcile learn:FILE:<source record id> (frozen stability sample, used here) with domain_models.resource_uid producing learn:RESOURCE:<id>, so 4.2 and other adapters do not publish two stable identities.

rollback: Stop calling ResourceCenter; delete_cache(semester) atomically replaces the encrypted index with an empty record. Downloaded files and the user directory are untouched; the existing Learn course file list and download entry remain available. Do not convert the index to plaintext or bulk-delete archive directories.
next_step: Batch integration reconnects 4.1-4.5 on one commit, runs batch-level check, the full offline suite and contract linkage, and runs windows-2025; accepted is written by the remediation phase.
